issue.title: Host restart leaves %w waiters and land agents stranded with no auto-recovery
issue.description:
## Bug
- **Location:** sase agent auto-restart (covers live updates only) + sase bead work manual recovery
Nothing relaunches %w waiters or land agents after a host restart. On 2026-11-01, 27 FAILED dependency waiters (16 land + 11 phase) had no LLM work started and no done.json; recovery required manual sase bead work per epic. Compare sase agent auto-restart, which covers live updates only.
Repro: reboot host with waiting %w/land agents; observe FAILED with dead PID, no auto-relaunch; sase bead work per epic required.
Impact: 16 epic clans stalled after every host restart until manual recovery.

issue.creation_reason: Recovery after athena restart required manual sase bead work per epic; auto-restart covers live updates only and no path relaunches waiters after reboot.

evidence.note: Still unrecovered on 2026-11-03, 2.5 days after the 2026-11-01 07:26 reboot. Beads sase-1qh.7, sase-1pi.1, sase-1oe.4, sase-1q2.9.2, sase-1nv.5.1.4, sase-1nv.5.1.5, .5.1.6, .5.1.7, and sase-1nv.5.1 are in_progress, assigned to agents with no live process, so sase-1nv.land has been WAITING since 11-01 10:19. systemd SIGKILLed the sase-1nv.5.1.6 and sase-1nv.5.1.land waiters (journal: Stopping timed out. Killing.), so they have no done.json. Recovery gap: 7 of 8 .f0 agents launched 11-01 13:17 died with 'Failed to claim bead X ... already in_progress and assigned to X', because the dead owner still held the claim. Settlement for SIGTERMed monitors also crashed on update skew: an auto-update ff landed 18 min before the reboot, giving release_workspace() artifacts_timestamp and missing decide_workspace_retention binding errors.
